policy: Canonical primary execution uses one estimator job and threadpoolctl-enforced single-thread numerical kernels.
platform_binding: Aggregate metrics and every derived analysis table are portable across operating systems. The per-fit prediction and score SHA-256 signatures are not: they depend on the BLAS build, so full_empirical_replay reproduces exactly only on the declared canonical platform. Verification on another platform is expected to reproduce all derived tables byte-for-byte while differing in continuous-score signatures.
serialization: All scientific CSV and JSON artifacts are written with LF newlines through ml_reproducibility.serialization so that byte identity is a property of the experiment rather than of the host operating system.
